rules.text: If the pie-chart slice inscriptions identify source categories and their shares of global energy consumption, and those shares are comparable category shares, then the category with the greatest printed percentage is the largest global energy consumption category. If that category is Nuclear, the public routing criterion calls for selecting the Nuclear priority-monitoring route.
rules.component: pie-slice labels and percentages/task routing relation
rules.conditions: The chart title and slice labels accurately describe the dashboard's relevant global energy-consumption categories, the printed percentages encode comparable shares, and the form's Nuclear option routes the identified largest category to priority monitoring.
